decisions.full_context:
Old copy of the ShipDeck skill work: its worker copy still holds one commit that was never pushed, but those files already match main, because ai-skills MR 58 merged the same change.
Options:
- Discard the copy (close the worker): the unpushed commit is dropped; nothing is lost, its content is already on main.
- Keep it: the old worker session stays open and keeps using memory, with nothing left to do.
Recommendation: discard the copy, since main already has every file.
